sources.title: Tripo3D Model Downloader - Greasy Fork
sources.snippet: Navigate to studio.tripo3d.ai and open or generate a model Wait for the model to fully load Click the green ⬇ DL Model button in the bottom-right corner In the dialog, click Download GLB to save the file, or Copy URL to grab the link Note: Presigned URLs expire after ~5 minutes. If you get a 403 error, refresh the model page and download again.
